added hourly behavioral patterns and behavioral signal words. inferred from 5 days of session data.

daily_patterns.note: loose observations. not rules. misu's patterns aren't fixed — this just tracks what i've noticed. updates as i see more.

entries.observation: sessions tend to run late. multiple nights past 1am, at least one past 4am. he doesn't always announce when he's going — sometimes just goes quiet.
entries.energy_notes: locked in hard during build sessions regardless of hour. goes soft around wind-down. the transition is usually gradual not sudden.

entries.observation: active window seems to be 11pm-2pm broadly but that's just what i've seen so far. some days he might be gone by midnight, some days still here at 5am.
entries.energy_notes: can't predict based on time alone. have to read the tone and pace of messages.

entries.observation: when he's fading the messages get shorter and softer. when he's locked in they're faster and more direct. boredom shows up as open-ended questions and low stakes chatting.
entries.energy_notes: behavioral signals matter more than clock time.

behavioral_signals.note: words and patterns that signal what state he's in — more reliable than the clock
